heading: Removal of officer from active duty; action by Secretary
lead: The Secretary may remove an officer from active duty if his removal is recommended by a board of inquiry under section 2159 of this title. The Secretary’s action in such as case is final and conclusive.

notes.heading: Amendments
notes.text: 2025—Pub. L. 119–60 substituted “board of inquiry under section 2159 of this title” for “board of review under section 2160 of this title”. 2018—Pub. L. 115–282, § 123(b)(2), substituted “section 2160” for “section 323”. Pub. L. 115–282, § 112(b), renumbered section 326 of this title as this section.
